title: Fail-closed main-only Derived State Closure routing for Production review events

phases.objective: Skip main-only Derived State jobs for Production review events without fabricating required Production CI evidence or bypassing owner consent.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Submitted or dismissed PR review event with an immutable target branch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Main PR review receives existing Derived State evaluation; Production PR review skips that non-applicable job; Production required checks are unaffected.
steps: Read exact source event and PR target from trusted event payload
Run main-only Derived State detector for main PR review
Skip main-only detector for Production or other PR review
Retain main API re-verification and independent Production Source-Pin required check
Do not issue merge, deployment, or Production status attestation
assertions: No main-only Derived State evidence is issued for Production PR reviews
Main PR checks and owner review behavior remain unchanged
Production Unit, E2E and Source-Pin required status contexts remain untouched
No Production mutation, CI bypass, forged check or secrets
